autonomous_exploratory_v1.evidence: SIM, not a phenotype inferred from Xenium. Identity-gated cells are assigned functional machinery for the listed programs, including receptors absent from the panel. Recognition and cytotoxic/clearance competence require separate scenario declarations.

S0.title: Exploratory candidate epithelium; antigen recognition and effector competence unknown

biology.evidence: SIM assumptions; no field concentration, recognition, protein competence, exhaustion, cycle phase or rate is measured.
biology.nerve_placement: A declared 80 um line just beyond the halo envelope on the initial tumor-facing side (outside all t=0 disks); fixed and not inferred from Xenium.

division.axis: long axis of the simulated cell (minimum rotated rectangle); seeded random axis if degenerate
division.cycle_label: Accelerated 24 h tumour cycle, explicitly labelled; real LUAD doubles in weeks to months.
division.growth: the target area rises linearly from A0 to 2*A0 over the cycle
division.local_pressure: mean one-sided pressure of the cell and its simulated contacts

evidence: SIM: every number below is a declared, uncalibrated modelling assumption unless its note says otherwise.

fields.boundary: Zero flux on the rectangle enclosing the halo. Nutrients enter only at declared perfused endothelial sites.
fields.context_sources: Context has constant declared basal nutrient consumption; endothelial perfusion is scenario assigned. Context cells have no programs or decisions.
fields.matrix_integrator: Implicit Euler, tick 10 min; all other fields quasi-steady. Sources deposited conservatively. Matrix persists after secretion and decays.

geometry.contact_handover: At t=0 the contact graph is exactly the measured graph (H04). A t=0 pair keeps its measured status while its site distance stays within contact_memory_um of the t=0 value; afterwards the simulated geometry decides. Provenance is recorded as measured_contact_persisting or simulated_contact.
geometry.measured_contact: polygon gap <= 1 um (MANUAL H04), valid at t=0 only
geometry.model: Bounded power (Laguerre) diagram: the simulated cell of body i is its power cell intersected with its disk of radius rho_i (weight rho_i^2). Cells tile the union of disks and cannot overlap by construction.
geometry.radius_rule: rho_i^2 = kappa_i * A0_i; kappa_i is fitted once at t=0 so the power-cell area approaches the measured polygon area, then inherited by daughters
geometry.simulated_contact: H04 applied to simulated cells: power-adjacent bodies whose cells share an interface or whose disks are within contact_max_gap_um; always labelled simulated_contact. Mechanical forces act only through shared interfaces.
geometry.site_at_t0: centroid of the measured Xenium polygon (not obsm/spatial)
geometry.t0_display: measured polygons are shown at t=0; simulated cells thereafter; the two are never mixed silently
geometry.target_area_at_t0: the fitted t=0 power-cell area, so the measured configuration is a declared mechanical equilibrium; the measured area is kept for reporting

local_policy_m1.description: Legacy mechanics exercise; use the prepared loader with static or baseline scenarios.
local_policy_m1.name: m1_exercise_policy

anchoring.note: Viscoelastic attachment to matrix: v -= k * (x - anchor); the anchor creeps toward the site with time constant creep_min. Transient pushes (passing lymphocytes) recover; sustained pressure (growth) displaces permanently. Self-propelled cells carry their anchor.

compression_constraint.method: New specimen nucleus/cell area q10 by provisional runtime type, clipped to [0.1,0.8]. Global new-specimen fallback if a type has fewer than 30 valid objects. Structural proxy only.

mechanics.domain: ROI and halo are mechanically active. Context bodies (halo, occluded) whose t=0 site lies farther than roi_radius + halo_um - fixed_ring_um from the ROI centre form a fixed boundary. Only ROI cells, their daughters and recruited cells may act; crossing the ROI boundary is tracked, never a deletion. Mobile sites are confined by a wall at the inner edge of the fixed ring (radius roi_radius + halo_um - fixed_ring_um); every confinement is counted.
mechanics.force: F_i = -sum_j ((P_i + P_j) / 2) * L_ij * n_ij over simulated contacts; free edges follow from the disk arcs

hard_core.note: Power-adjacent sites are projected apart to at least max(fraction * (rho_i + rho_j), sqrt(|w_i - w_j|) + margin), the two-body condition for neither cell to vanish. Pairs already closer in the measured t=0 geometry keep their t=0 distance as their core.

mechanics.pressure: one-sided P_i = max(0, (A0_i - A_i) / A0_i): cells resist compression; there is no cohesive tension

rescue.note: Disabled for the constrained mechanics profile; weights cannot inflate to rescue compressed cells.

modes.self_propelled: Default. Self-propelled site (v0 * persistent heading * permeability) inside the packed power diagram; neighbours are displaced by pressure and neighbour exchanges happen as topological changes of the diagram (MANUAL H18: motion displaces, never occupies void).
modes.swap: Plan alternative kept for comparison: discrete exchange of two sites on the contact graph. Rejected as default in M1 because exchanges scramble passive cells (see docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md).

migration.permeability_note: Class factor in [0, 1]. self_propelled: speed is scaled by the interface-weighted mean factor of current neighbours. swap: acceptance probability of an exchange with that neighbour. Fixed bodies are 0 (never displaced).
migration.speed_note: SIM assumption inherited from prototype; not fitted to this sample.
migration.traction_note: self_propelled speed = v0 * sum_j L_ij * permeability_j / max(sum_j L_ij, substrate_perimeter_fraction * 2 * pi * r_eq): lymphocytes crawl on neighbours, so they slow at void edges and cannot cross empty space.

prototype_notes.approach: APPROACH_TUMOR (CD8 within sensing_radius_um of a live tumor cell) and APPROACH_CORPSE (macrophage within corpse_signal_radius_um of an apoptotic cell) are directed crawling programs that end on contact or after approach_max_min.
prototype_notes.corpses: Dead cells remain as corpses until a macrophage completes EFFEROCYTOSE; corpses not cleared within corpse_degradation_min are removed as secondary necrosis.
prototype_notes.crowding: Prototype relaxes crowding gates (division blocked above local pressure 0.4, was 0.25; cycle entry allowed up to 0.25, was 0.15). Compression area floors are unchanged.
prototype_notes.status: Uncalibrated prototype. Rates, recognition and competences are declared assumptions, not measurements.
prototype_notes.t0_cycle: No initial cell is marked Tumor_proliferating by this workflow; malignant cycling cannot be established from these provisional clusters.
prototype_notes.t0_state: t0 AUCell scores and percentiles by provisional cell type and within-type detection-depth decile. AUCell is not UCell. Daughters inherit the initial profile; RNA is not dynamically resimulated.

provider.semantics: Probabilities rank licensed behaviors; never event rates. Invalid individual answers start no program; clocks continue. No retry. Journal before applying; identical requests reuse stored responses.

scheduler.wake: New relevant heterotypic contact, field-bin crossing, program completion, cycle checkpoint, ROI entry. Initial relevant contacts count as new; initial proliferating annotation is a SIM phase checkpoint. Quiet cells receive no synthetic WAIT.
